title: The Year of Living Dangerously
description: An Australian reporter (Mel Gibson) betrays his friend (Linda Hunt) and his lover (Sigourney Weaver) in volatile 1965 Indonesia.

title: Suburban Commando
description: A warrior (Hulk Hogan) from another galaxy escapes to Earth and moves in with an architect (Christopher Lloyd) and his wife (Shelley Duvall).

title: City Hall
description: The New York mayor (Al Pacino) and his idealistic deputy (John Cusack) cope with scandal generated by a policeman's accidental shooting of a black boy.

title: The Man With Two Brains
description: A brain surgeon (Steve Martin) finds true love with a mass of cranial nerve tissue he wishes were his wife's (Kathleen Turner).

title: Pennies From Heaven
description: A sheet-music salesman (Steve Martin) escapes his wife, girlfriend (Bernadette Peters) and the Depression through his songs.

title: Almost Heroes
description: A tracker (Chris Farley) and his entourage help a fop (Matthew Perry) try to beat Lewis & Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Fandango
description: A prankster (Kevin Costner), an ROTC student (Judd Nelson) and their buddies hop in a Cadillac for one last fling in 1971 Texas.

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: Salvagers (Michael Caine, Sally Field) seeking cash and a madman (Telly Savalas) seeking plutonium are trapped with survivors in an upside-down ocean liner.

title: Surf Ninjas
description: Two California surfers (Ernie Reyes Jr., Nicolas Cowan) try to overthrow a dictator as long-lost princes of a place called Patu San.

title: Sweet November
description: A workaholic executive (Keanu Reeves) and an unconventional woman (Charlize Theron) agree to a personal relationship for a trial period of one month.

title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
description: A nightclub owner finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob; the lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.

title: Little Children
description: A dissatisfied housewife (Kate Winslet) and the husband (Patrick Wilson) of a documentary filmmaker (Jennifer Connelly) have secret trysts while their spouses are at work.

title: Undisputed III: Redemption
description: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

title: The Prince of Pennsylvania
description: A teenager (Keanu Reeves) kidnaps his coal-miner father (Fred Ward), hoping his mother (Bonnie Bedelia) will sell their land for the ransom.

title: Overnight Delivery
description: A college student must prevent an impending disaster when he erroneously sends a poison-pen letter to his girlfriend.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
description: Their mixed-up family follows when an unhappy teen (Hillary Wolf) and her stepbrother flee into the woods.

title: Alex & Me
description: Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: The Accidental Tourist
description: A numb travel-writer (William Hurt) takes up with his dog trainer (Geena Davis) after his son dies and his wife (Kathleen Turner) leaves.

title: Alien Autopsy
description: In the 1990s two men (Ant McPartlin, Declan Donnelly) produce a fake video that purports to be footage of an alien autopsy.

title: No Reservations
description: A career-centered chef (Catherine Zeta-Jones) faces important changes in her life when she becomes her young niece's guardian and crosses forks with a brash employee in her kitchen.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: The Ant Bully
description: Tired of weathering constant attacks on their colony, ants shrink a destructive boy (Zach Tyler Eisen) to their size and sentence him to live among them until he learns the errors of his ways.

title: Alex & Emma
description: A struggling writer (Luke Wilson) falls in love with a stenographer (Kate Hudson) while trying to finish his new novel in 30 days.

title: Michael Collins
description: An Irish freedom fighter (Liam Neeson) engineers the assassinations of British officials following the failed Easter Rising of 1916.

title: Tequila Sunrise
description: A narcotics officer (Kurt Russell) uses a woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) to catch his buddy, a big-time cocaine dealer (Mel Gibson) ready to retire.

title: Preacher's Kid
description: A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

title: Mr. Wonderful
description: If a man (Matt Dillon) finds his ex-wife (Annabella Sciorra) a husband, he can then put her alimony toward his bowling-alley dream.

title: Frequency
description: Thirty years after the death of his father, a police officer is stunned to find himself communicating with him thanks to an old ham radio.

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Corrina, Corrina
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) brings joy to a Jewish widower (Ray Liotta) and his young daughter (Tina Majorino) in 1959 Los Angeles.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: Fathers' Day
description: Two Californians (Robin Williams, Billy Crystal) seek a former girlfriend's missing son, each believing he is the father of the boy.

title: Forget Paris
description: Friends at a restaurant recall the romance of a yuppie couple (Billy Crystal, Debra Winger) who met in Paris four years before.

title: The Salton Sea
description: An addict (Val Kilmer) works undercover for two police officers and deals with a sadistic dealer (Vincent D'Onofrio) while trying to find his wife's killers.

title: Presumed Innocent
description: A married prosecutor (Harrison Ford) hires an attorney (Raul Julia) to defend him against charges of murdering his seductive colleague.

title: Fracture
description: A hotshot prosecutor (Ryan Gosling) squares off against a cunning engineer (Anthony Hopkins) who tried to murder his wife and is now defending himself in court.

title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
description: A CIA operative goes undercover to find a former agent selling nuclear secrets to the Russians.

title: Men Don't Leave
description: An indebted widow (Jessica Lange) sells the family home and starts over with her two sons (Chris O'Donnell, Charlie Korsmo) in Baltimore.
